title: Regime B generic content-block spec
description: IR for Regime B (content-dependent blocks). Replaces the closed levels[]+styles{}+body_block_grammar model with an OPEN-VOCABULARY clusters[] model. Two invariants make it generic, not if-else (docs/19 s1): (a) role_label is a free string DISCOVERED per document, never an enum; (b) every block maps to exactly one cluster, and every cluster has a build_action, so the mapping is TOTAL with a raw_fallback default — unknown blocks are carried, never dropped.

evidence.description: Provenance of the two evidence sources merged into this spec.

probe.description: e.g. evals/probe2.lua (pandoc block sequence + inline signals).

style_catalog.description: Style definitions keyed by styleId, sourced from officecli (NOT pandoc). Carries the fields pandoc's docx reader drops — align, first-line/left indent, tabs, spacing — so a cluster's typed build_action can reproduce them. Joined to clusters by styleId.

coverage.description: Totality guarantee. ratio MUST be 1.0: raw_fallback is the default cluster, so no block is left unassigned (docs/19 tru (b)).

signature.description: NON-SEMANTIC presentation signature (docs/19 s2.1). The secondary cluster key, used when styleId is absent (direct-format docs). Deliberately excludes the meaning of style names.

cluster_key.description: Which key gathered this cluster. styleId = the author's own pre-made grouping (primary); signature = format-signature fallback for direct-format blocks.

role_label.description: OPEN VOCABULARY. A free-text role the agent DISCOVERS and names from evidence (e.g. 'chapter-heading', 'figure-caption', 'reference-entry', or a wholly NEW label). NOT constrained to an enum — that openness is what makes the system generic rather than if-else. Use 'unclassified' when no confident role emerges (paired with a raw_fallback build_action).

target_style.description: styleId to APPLY when building a member of this cluster on the typed path. Null when the cluster is carried verbatim (raw_fallback).

context_rule.description: Human-readable structural context that disambiguates the role, e.g. 'follows an image => caption', 'top-level, starts a chapter'. Derived from block order, not hardcoded per type.

members.description: Block indices (probe row `i`) belonging to this cluster.

build_action.description: How a member is materialised on build. This is the TOTAL mapping's payload: typed clusters take the typed path; everything else falls to raw_fallback with an explicit tier.

mode.description: typed = apply target_style + pour content. raw_fallback = carry the source OOXML verbatim (default branch — the anti-if-else guarantee).

fallback_tier.description: Only for mode=raw_fallback. Ordered by dependency-robustness (docs/20 s4): build-on-copy (keeps all parts+rels; safest) > dump-replay (officecli, structure-aware) > raw-splice (needs safe-placement + dependency-closure).

needs_dep_closure.description: True when the block references another part (hyperlink->rels, image->media, chart->xlsx). A raw-splice of such a block MUST copy the dependency closure or it dangles (the rId8 lesson, docs/19 s2.2).
